413:t_1:172.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「My great will... To make the world know the power of the great god, I hereby declare the beginning of a new holy war.」

413:t_1:173.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「We will be victorious. To bring absolute order to this planet, and to build upon it an ideal land filled with peace and prosperity.」

413:t_1:174.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Follow me. That alone is the path to imperishable happiness.」

413:t_1:177.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「Another emissary from the heavens...!」

413:t_1:178.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Ensign $$レド$$... You were notified to shift to combat readiness. What kind of joke is this?」

413:t_1:179.en:
$$レド$$
「You are the one who's joking.」

413:t_1:180.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Hardly the words of an Alliance soldier.」

413:t_1:181.en:
$$レド$$
「This is Earth. It's not the $$銀河同盟$$!」

413:t_1:182.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「But it is a planet where humans live. We bear responsibility for its future.」

413:t_1:183.en:
$$レド$$
「...The old me would have accepted your words without a single doubt.」

413:t_1:184.en:
$$レド$$
「But on this planet I've met many people and learned many things...」

413:t_1:186.en:
$$レド$$
「Responsibility!? No! This planet has a world built by the people who live here! There's no way it's right to destroy that!」

413:t_1:187.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Our justice has not changed. Do not hesitate.」

413:t_1:188.en:
$$レド$$
「I've said everything I can... Come, Chamber!!」

413:t_2:3.en: ～ $$ガルガンティア船団$$, Fleet Commander's Room ～

413:t_2:4.en:
$$リジット$$
「...Can you hear me, everyone in the $$ガルガンティア船団$$? I am $$リジット$$, the Fleet Commander.」

413:t_2:5.en:
$$リジット$$
「As I already announced, out in the $$霧の海$$ right now, those who are targeting this $$ガルガンティア$$ are fighting $$レド$$, whom you all know.」

413:t_2:6.en:
$$リジット$$
「$$フェアロック$$ entrusted this $$ガルガンティア$$ to me.」

413:t_2:7.en:
$$リジット$$
「The previous Fleet Commander thought about this fleet's future until the very end. I want to live up to that!」

413:t_2:8.en:
$$リジット$$
「I want to protect the $$ガルガンティア$$ that the previous Fleet Commander loved... this fleet that carries all your lives!」

413:t_2:9.en:
$$リジット$$
「...But I am powerless. That is exactly why I want you to lend me your strength!」

413:t_2:10.en:
$$リジット$$
「If you want to protect this fleet... $$ガルガンティア$$, the bulwark of our way of life... then please, help me!」

413:t_2:11.en:
$$クラウン$$
「Can you hear that, $$リジット$$? Everyone says they'll help you.」

413:t_2:12.en:
$$オルダム$$
「That's how it should be, $$リジット$$. You, we, and they are all members of this fleet.」

413:t_2:13.en:
$$リジット$$
「Thank you... Thank you, everyone!」

413:t_2:14.en:
$$リジット$$
「I will now use the power of this $$ガルガンティア$$, which the previous Fleet Commander entrusted to me!」

413:t_2:18.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...To think something like this was hidden in $$ガルガンティア$$.」

413:t_2:19.en:
$$オルダム$$
「This is the great legacy that has been handed down to the Fleet Commanders.」

413:t_2:20.en:
$$リジット$$
「This is what Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$ entrusted to me...」

413:t_2:21.en:
$$オルダム$$
「It is said that this power was once meant to revive the wounded Earth.」

413:t_2:22.en:
$$オルダム$$
「But I am told it was also the power that destroyed the world. And it was entrusted to us... the Fleet's Five Sages.」

413:t_2:24.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Awakening a weapon of a lost age once more... I ask whether you are prepared to commit that taboo. $$リジット$$... leader of $$ガルガンティア$$.」

413:t_2:25.en:
$$リジット$$
「I don't mind. I have a duty to protect all the comrades gathered on this ship.」

413:t_2:26.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Then... let us use that power now.」

413:t_2:27.en:
$$リジット$$
「$$エイミー$$ will give us the position...!」

413:t_2:28.en:
$$クラウン$$
「35 east, 58 south... Target coordinate correction complete!」

413:t_2:29.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Loading complete. Shockwave-interference water film, begin spraying.」

413:t_2:30.en:
$$リジット$$
「Verdurous Bug System, activate! Fire!!」

413:t_3:3.en: ～ $$フロンティア船団$$ Chief Aide's Office ～

413:t_3:4.en:
$$三島$$
「...We failed to annihilate $c, but there is no need to hurry.」

413:t_3:5.en:
$$三島$$
「They have their uses too, such as keeping the $$サイデリアル$$ in check.」

413:t_3:7.en:
$$三島$$
「Still, seeing you like this again is a surprise. I thought you had died in the $$再世戦争$$.」

413:t_3:8.en:
$$三島$$
「$$グレイス・オコナー$$... or should I call you $$グレイス・ゴドゥヌワ$$?」

413:t_3:9.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Names hardly matter. And neither does the body...」

413:t_3:10.en:
$$三島$$
「Right, I forgot. For you people of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$, the body is nothing but a vessel.」

413:t_3:11.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「That $$再世戦争$$ was a fine place to collect data. Thanks to it, our research on the $$バジュラ$$ advanced by leaps and bounds...」

413:t_3:12.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「And then we were able to test the fruits of that research on another swarm of $$バジュラ$$ we found at the galactic center.」

413:t_3:13.en:
$$三島$$
「Controlling the $$バジュラ$$ with $$インプラント$$ rounds and fold jamming... Magnificent, the technology of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

413:t_3:14.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「It's also thanks to a sponsor like you.」

413:t_3:15.en:
$$三島$$
「I'm not acting out of self-interest. I just want to give up on the $$地球圏$$, with its endless turmoil, as soon as possible and set out for the galaxy.」

413:t_3:16.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「By analyzing the $$バジュラ$$ biology, fold technology has also made rapid progress.」

413:t_3:17.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「With enough energy, folding to the galactic center is even possible.」

413:t_3:18.en:
$$三島$$
「Splendid. It was worth accepting your proposal.」

413:t_3:19.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「You and I... no, Galaxy and Frontier are partners, after all.」

413:t_3:20.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Now that we hold the power of the $$バジュラ$$, the only obstacle left is the $$サイデリアル$$.」

413:t_3:21.en:
$$三島$$
「Heh heh... If we dispose of them and control the $$バジュラ$$ Queen, ruling the galaxy is no pipe dream...」

413:t_3:22.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「To that end, I'd like to take down the ruler of the $$サイデリアル$$, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, here on Earth.」

413:t_3:23.en:
$$三島$$
「In that case, $c can be put to use as well...」

413:t_3:24.en:
$$三島$$
「I hold a personal grudge against the $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ among them. Once the $$サイデリアル$$ are dealt with, I'll crush them first.」

413:t_3:25.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
(As ever, $$レオン・三島$$... I don't dislike that dreamy side of you...)

413:t_3:26.en:
$$三島$$
「But is it all right about $$ブレラ・スターン$$?」

413:t_3:27.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「No problem. A soldier under imperfect control is worthless.」

413:t_3:28.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「And I've gotten hold of material to take his place.」

413:t_3:29.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
(Heh heh... If I analyze her, we'll gain even more combat strength. Then the esteemed Chief Aide will be of no further use...)

413:t_3:33.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

413:t_3:35.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm sorry, $$エイミー$$. For worrying you all this time.」

413:t_3:36.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's okay... Because you came back to us like this.」

413:t_3:37.en:
$$レド$$
「And besides, I... the $$クジライカ$$...」

413:t_3:38.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...Let's think about that together, from now on.」

413:t_3:40.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You had your reasons for doing it. And we had our reasons for not wanting you to...」

413:t_3:41.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Instead of just pushing through your own ideas, let's think about the other person and figure out together what to do.」

413:t_3:42.en:
$$レド$$
「Can I... think about it too?」
